evidence.note: Isaac fathers ליַעקֻובֿ. The same man is then named יַעקֻובֿ as the father of Judah and his brothers.
Jacob receives the Hebrew name יַעֲקֹב as he emerges holding Esau’s heel, עֲקֵב.

name: יַעקֻובֿ
summary: Matthew uses the Syriac name יַעקֻובֿ for Isaac’s son and Judah’s father. Genesis associates the corresponding Hebrew name with Jacob grasping his brother’s heel at birth.
